content.title: Goals and Highlights: Sporting vs Bodo/Glimt in UEFA Champions League (5-0) | 03/17/2026 - VAVEL USA
content.text: Sporting5 - 0Bodo GlimtArt: VAVELADVERTISEMENTDiscover moreFitness trackersLeague standings updatesSoccer jerseys124' - Game over! Sporting are qualified!The referee blows the final whistle at Alvalade. In a controlled match, Sporting thrashed Bodo Glimt 5-0, overturning the 5-3 aggregate score, and advanced to the Champions League quarter-finals. Thank you for following the game with us in real time. ⚽ 120' - GOAL FOR SPORTING!Rafael Nel scores Sporting's fifth goal of the match, increasing the Portuguese team's lead. On a play down the right flank, Nel enters the box, unleashes a cross-shot with his right foot, and finds the back of the net past goalkeeper Haikin. Sporting extends their advantage in the tie. 114'Almost a GOAL for Bodo Glimt. In the play, Andreas Helmersen receives the ball in the air, heads it firmly, and goalkeeper Rui Silva makes the save. The visiting team is having a lot of difficulty defining the score and reacting in the match against Sporting. ↔️ 109'Changes for Sporting. Maximiliano Araújo and Francisco Trincão leave the field and are replaced by Ousmane Diomande and Souleymane Faye in the home team. Sporting is securing its place in the quarter-finals of the competition. 2º/105'The second half of extra time begins. Jostein Gundersen leaves the field and is replaced by Haitam Aleesami for Bodo Glimt. In a controlled game, Sporting is thrashing Bodo Glimt 4-0 and reversing the aggregate score to 4-3 in the second leg of the Champions League Round of 16. Follow the extra time period with us.Discover moreUEFA Champions League historySports apparelSports streaming service subscription107'End of the first half of extra time. In a controlled game, Sporting is thrashing Bodo Glimt 4-0 and reversing the aggregate score to 4-3, in the second leg of the Champions League round of 16. We will return to the final stage shortly. 🟨 103'Yellow card for Sporting. Nuno Santos is shown a yellow card by the referee. Santos is suspended for the remainder of the match and risks being sent off if he receives another yellow card. The home team still holds the advantage. 98'The game becomes bogged down at Alvalade. Maxi Araújo fouls Daniel Bassi, interrupting Bodo Glimt's play. Sporting tightens its marking in the match and secures a 4-0 victory over Bodo Glimt. The advantage is with the Portuguese team. 95'Bodo Glimt is blocked and misses the chance. In the ensuing play, Daniel Bassi passes to Ulrik Saltnes, who controls the ball on the left. Saltnes attempts a cross-shot with his right foot, but the ball hits the Sporting defense. The game becomes very competitive. Discover moreFootball training equipmentBest goals compilationSoccerMatch day experiencesTeam jerseysSports statistics analysis⚽ 91' - GOAL FOR SPORTING!Maxi Araújo scores the fourth goal for the Portuguese team at Alvalade. In the opening minutes of extra time, the left-back enters the box, shoots across goal with his left foot, and finds the back of the net past goalkeeper Haikin. Sporting are securing their qualification. 90' - First half of extra time beginsThe ball is rolling again at Alvalade. In a controlled game, Sporting beat Bodo Glimt 3-0, tying the aggregate score at 3-3, in the second leg of the Champions League round of 16. Follow our live coverage of the first half of extra time. 95' - Game over! Extra time!The referee blows the whistle at Alvalade. We'll have extra time! In a controlled game, Sporting beat Bodo Glimt 3-0, tying the aggregate score at 3-3, in the second leg of the Champions League Round of 16. We'll be back shortly to cover two more fifteen-minute periods. ↔️ 90+5'The referee adds five more minutes of stoppage time to the second half. Sondre Fet leaves the field and is replaced by Sondre Auklend in the Bodo Glimt team. Another change for the visiting team, which is having difficulty creating plays in the match. 88'Almost a FOURTH GOAL for Sporting. Nuno Santos crosses the ball into the area, Mortel Hjulmand heads it from the middle of the box and goalkeeper Haikin makes a great save. Sporting maintains the pressure in the match and looks for the fourth goal. ↔️ 83'More changes for Bodo Glimt. Hakon Evjen and Ole Didrik Blomberg leave the field and are replaced by Daniel Bassi and Isak Dybvik Maatta for the visiting team. Bodo Glimt is looking for a fourth goal to secure qualification in the match. ↔️ 78'Changes for Bodo Glimt. Kasper Hogh and Jens Petter Hauge leave the field and are replaced by Andreas Helmersen and Ulrik Saltnes in the visiting team. Bodo Glimt is looking for the first goal to secure qualification. ⚽ 77' - GOAL FOR SPORTING!GOAL FOR SPORTING! Luis Suárez scores Sporting's third goal. The striker converts the penalty with his right foot, beating goalkeeper Haikin. The home team equalizes, making the aggregate score 3-3 against Bodo Glimt. 🥅 76'PENALTY FOR SPORTING. Fredrik Bjorkan fouls Fresneda inside the area and the referee awards a penalty. Sporting has a great chance to score their third goal and increase their aggregate lead. The home team maintains the pressure. 🟨 74'Yellow card for Sporting. Iván Fresneda commits a hard foul on Fredrik Bjorkan and is shown a yellow card by the referee. Fresneda is on a yellow card suspension and risks being sent off if he receives another yellow card. 71'Almost a THIRD GOAL for Sporting. Nuno Santos, who has just entered the game, creates a play and passes to Zeno Debast. Debast attempts a shot with his right foot from the edge of the area and goalkeeper Haikin makes a good save. The home team maintains the pressure. ↔️ 🟨 67'Yellow card and substitution. Kasper Hogh commits a hard foul on Maxi Araújo and is shown a yellow card by the referee. Following this, Pedro Gonçalves and Hidemasa Morita leave the field and are replaced by Nuno Santos and Daniel Bragança in the Sporting team.↔️ 64'Substitution for Sporting. Eduardo Quaresma leaves the field and is replaced by Zeno Debast for the home team. Rui Borges makes the first change to the Sporting team to regain momentum and look for the third goal. ⚽ 60' - GOAL FOR SPORTING!Pote Gonçalves scores the second goal at Alvalade. In the play, the striker enters the area, finishes with a cross-shot with his left foot and shakes the net past goalkeeper Haikin. Sporting increases their lead and is close to a draw on aggregate. Bodo Glimt still wins 3-2. 54'Sporting applies pressure. Pote Gonçalves unleashes a right-footed shot inside the area, but goalkeeper Haikin makes the save. Sporting are looking for a second goal in the match, but are having difficulty sealing the score and increasing their lead. 49'Bodo Glimt almost scores the equalizer. In the play, Jens Petter Hauge passes the ball to Sondre Fet. The midfielder enters the area, shoots with his left foot, and goalkeeper Rui Silva makes the save. The visiting team is looking for the equalizing goal. 🟨 45'Yellow card for Sporting. Morten Hjulmand commits a hard foul on Ole Didrik Blomberg and is shown a yellow card by the referee. Hjulmand is on a yellow card suspension and risks being sent off if he receives another yellow card. 2º/45' - Second half beginsSecond half begins! The ball is rolling again at Alvalade. For now, Sporting is winning against Bodo Glimt 1-0 in the second leg of the Champions League round of 16. On aggregate, Bodo Glimt is winning the tie 3-1. 45' - End of the first halfThe first half ends at Alvalade. For now, Sporting is winning against Bodo Glimt 1-0 in the second leg of the Champions League round of 16. On aggregate, Bodo Glimt is winning the tie 3-1. We'll return shortly to follow the second half. 40'Almost a SECOND GOAL for Sporting. Maxi Araújo advances down the left and passes to Pote. The striker shoots with his right foot from the edge of the box, but goalkeeper Haikin makes the save. The home team maintains the pressure in the match and looks for a second goal. 36'Sporting tightens its marking in the match. Maxi Araújo fouls Fredrik Sjovold, interrupting Bodo Glimt's play with an infraction. The referee stops the match. The home team tries to block Bodo Glimt's attacks. ⚽ 33' - GOAL FOR SPORTING!Gonçalo Inácio opens the scoring for the home team. From a corner kick, the defender rises highest to head the ball into the back of the net past goalkeeper Haikin. Sporting extends their lead in the match and reduces the score to 3-1 against Bodo Glimt. 28'Sporting maintains the pressure but fails to open the scoring. Luis Suárez is set up by Trincão, attempts a shot from the edge of the area with his right foot and misses the target. The home team is losing 3-0 on aggregate and needs to overturn the result. 23'Sporting tightens its marking. Pote Gonçalves arrives late in a challenge with Hakon Evjen and interrupts Bodo Glimt's build-up play. The home team's attack maintains the pressure in the match, trying to open the scoring. 18'Sporting almost scores. Geny Catamo passes to Pote, who shoots with his right foot from the edge of the box, but goalkeeper Haikin makes the save. Sporting continues to press and misses another good chance to open the scoring in the home game. 15'Bodo Glimt attempts to open the scoring. On a counter-attack, Kasper Hogh enters the area on the right side, shoots with his right foot and misses the target. The visiting team misses the chance to take the lead in the away match. 10'Sporting are applying pressure. Maxi Araújo passes to Luis Suárez, who controls the ball inside the area. The striker shoots with his left foot, and goalkeeper Haikin makes another good save. The home team maintains the pressure in the match. 07'Almost a GOAL for Sporting. On the left wing, Pote enters the box, shoots across goal with his right foot, and goalkeeper Haikin makes the first save of the match. Sporting starts applying pressure in the opening minutes and misses a good chance. 🟨 05'Yellow card for Bodo Glimt. Ole Didrik Blomberg commits a hard attacking foul on Maxi Araújo and is shown a yellow card by the referee. The striker is now on a yellow card and risks being sent off if he receives another one. 1º/00' - The game begins!The referee blows the whistle for the first time at Alvalade. The ball is rolling for the first half between Sporting and Bodo Glimt, in the second leg of the Champions League Round of 16. Follow our live coverage of this great match. Bodo/Glimt ReservesBodo/Glimt publishes list of players on the bench: Sondre Auklend, Julian Faye Lund, Haitam Aleesami, Daniel Bassi, Magnus Riisnaes, Isak Sjong, Isak Dybvik Määttä, Anders Klynge, Andreas Helmersen, August Mikkelsen, Ulrik Saltnes, Villads Nielsen. In the first leg, they spent a lot of time defending due to the pressure we exerted. I am sure they will leave a different image in the second leg. It will be very important that my team can hold on defensively. Therefore, it will be a very interesting game.” "It's a new game. I believe Sporting will be aggressive and give their all. They are an attacking team, with high intensity from the start. We will have to be prepared for that, but I can promise that we will also run and have intensity. We are a physical team and we run more than our rivals." "It's a new game. I believe Sporting will be aggressive and give their all. They are an attacking team, with high intensity from the start. We will have to be prepared for that, but I can promise that we will also run and have intensity. We are a physical team and we run more than our rivals." Speak, Rui Borges! - Sporting's Coach"I have a lot of faith. I said it right after the game in Bodo, I know it's difficult and that the difficulties will be great. The difficulty is already great given the 90-minute interval and being 3-0 down. Now, I also have a lot of faith in the resilience, the individual and collective capacity that this team has had and has demonstrated throughout the season, because it's not one game that defines the team and defines the individual and collective quality of Sporting. Everything else that comes before is what defines it. And, above all, the team has given that demonstration: it really wants to give a different image, it really wants to show that it is capable of doing and continuing to mark Sporting's history in a positive way, to do something unprecedented and extraordinary. We know we have to play an almost perfect game. We're going for that. The team's ambition is enormous and they have demonstrated it from the very beginning, from the first day I arrived at Sporting. And that's what will certainly happen tomorrow."
